card.title: Nintendo Switch HAC-CPU-01 motherboard overview and test points

source.title: Nintendo Switch Main Board Component and Test Point Map

claims.statement: The image shows an annotated overview of the Nintendo Switch HAC-CPU-01 motherboard with various sections marked A through H and numbered test points.
claims.evidence: Annotated red bounding boxes with letters A-H and numbered points overlaying the circuit board.

card.caveats: This image shows board layout and test point locations with section and point indices, but does not provide specific electrical voltage or resistance values.
